page.overview:
Who is Dr. S. Justacomins?

Dr. S. Justacomins was a minor character who appeared in the 2010 video-game, James Bond 007: Blood Stone.

Dr. S. Justacomins was a director of bio-engineering at the University of Stuttgart. He went missing from his home three weeks ago, thought to have absconded with one of his mistresses. He was kidnapped by mercenaries in the hire of Russian oligarch, Stefan Pomerov. He was brought to Istanbul, where he was held captive by Bernin in the Byzantine catacombs underneath the city, along with fellow bio-tech researchers Remy and Dr. Malcolm Tedworth. Little is known about his research, although it is thought to relate to the stabilization of biological compounds for transportation. While James Bond investigating about Tedworth in the catacombs he found his dead body with a single gunshot wound on his head.
